coverage.reason: No version-pinned SQLite source and WASI build can currently be reproduced in this repository. The independent JavaScript SQLite prerequisite is absent at the three pinned candidate paths.

sqlite.schema: CREATE TABLE inventory (sku TEXT PRIMARY KEY, price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, stock INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE requests (request_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sku TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL);
statements: SELECT sku, price_cents, stock FROM inventory WHERE sku = ?1
INSERT INTO requests(request_id, sku, quantity) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3)
UPDATE inventory SET stock = stock - ?2 WHERE sku = ?1 AND stock >= ?2
SELECT request_id, sku, quantity FROM requests ORDER BY request_id
sqlite.rowOrder: Every result is ordered by an explicit primary-key or ORDER BY clause.

requiredTargets.javascript: Repository-owned JSON parser, HMAC-SHA-256, SQLite execution, validation and canonical response renderer; native SQLite and WebCrypto shortcuts are prohibited.
requiredTargets.wasiLinearWasm: One material WASI module performs JSON parsing, HMAC-SHA-256, SQLite execution, validation and canonical response rendering; host code only supplies deterministic bytes and scheduling.

independentJavaScriptSqliteAudit.availabilityRule: Any present pinned candidate fails this blocked record and requires manual review of SQLite semantics and independence before implementation.

blockers.detail: The repository contains no SQLite amalgamation, source hash, compile flags, license manifest or reproducible SQLite build recipe.

In the recorded qualification environment, /opt/wasi-sdk/bin/clang and /usr/share/wasi-sysroot are absent, and the installed Rust toolchain has no wasm32-wasip1 standard library. No other host paths were probed.

The three pinned JavaScript SQLite candidate paths are absent. Using host SQLite or wrapping the Wasm SQLite build from JavaScript would violate the independent controlled-JavaScript target and identical-work contract.
The observed host SQLite 3.53.3 executable is not a source-pinned WASI build and cannot set the benchmark's required SQLite version.

unblockConditions: Commit an audited SQLite source revision, SHA-256, license notice, configuration and reproducible WASI build under a pinned toolchain.
Provide an independent JavaScript SQLite implementation that executes the same schema and SQL semantics without calling host SQLite or the Wasm target.
Freeze the SQLite version, compile flags, schema, statements, fixture generator, request bytes, key bytes and in-memory database bytes before implementation measurement.
Pass complete-response, final-database, tamper, SQL-order and concurrency-determinism differential tests before recording any performance sample.
